article.title: Verify a connection before you rely on it
article.excerpt: The built-in check only validates the fields you typed. Here is the test that actually proves a connection works.

p: Adding a connection runs a field-level check: required fields present, values shaped as expected. It is a form validation, not a live call to your provider — so a connection that passes the check can still fail on the first real send.
sections.note: Treat a passing check as "the form was filled in correctly". It is not evidence that the credentials are valid or that the sender is authorized.

sections.h: The only test that proves it
p: Send one real message to a number you control, then read the outcome. That single send exercises credentials, sender authorization and the route to a destination — none of which the field check touches.

steps.p: Send a message you can read. Mark it TRANSACTIONAL so suppression rules cannot quietly swallow it.

steps.h: Look it up in the log
steps.p: Find the row for that send. It carries the message ID, the provider and the normalized status.
Delivered means credentials and route are fine. Failed means read the error code. Accepted with no receipt yet means wait and re-read — absence of a receipt is not failure.

sections.h: What a failure is telling you
list: An authentication error means the credentials themselves are wrong, not the route.
A rejection naming the sender means the number or sender ID is not authorized for that destination — a registration problem, which is yours to resolve with the provider.
A rejection naming the destination means the country or network does not accept this sender type.
No error at all and no arrival means the message was accepted and the outcome is still unknown — diagnose it with the "messages accepted but not arriving" article.

article.scope: Delivery receipts come back wherever the provider reports delivery: every SMS provider, Resend on email and Meta on WhatsApp. A connection on a channel whose provider does not report delivery back can still be verified by sending, but there is no later status to read.
